permitted_materials_used: the 20 anonymous crops generated from the assigned boxes

procedure.rotations: none; all principal writing is upright

notes: Every supplied anonymous crop has been visually inspected. This record preserves written short forms, equality/isomorphism signs, source underlines, fractions, cancellations and folio numbers. No first reading or collation output was consulted. Uncertainty is concentrated in the cancelled fragments and several small accents/indices; mathematical context was not used to repair them.

boxes.scope: The entire upper author number.
boxes.evidence: Angular first digit with cross/foot, followed by a 5 with upper curve and lower turn: 45.

boxes.scope: The complete top prose line in this box; the overlapping upper folio belongs to B001.
boxes.evidence: A separate two-stroke equality sign follows ou/où; I do not expand it. The U and the closed oval 0 are separately visible below their tildes. A comma follows the second E expression. The last word has a terminal tall crossed t, hence définit.
boxes.uncertainty: A small raised mark above the final vowel supports où, but is not strong enough to exclude unaccented ou. The accent in définit is slight.

boxes.scope: Cancelled word and following live le.
boxes.evidence: An initial tall l-like loop and e-like low loop are crossed by a horizontal cancellation. Final joined strokes permit leur but are not fully separable. The following live le has its own tall l and low e.
boxes.uncertainty: The cancelled word is not fully recoverable; leur is a tentative reading only.

boxes.scope: The entire equation.
boxes.evidence: The E subscript has an arch and descending right leg below a tilde. The relation has two horizontal strokes, hence literal equality. The N subscript contains s and a separate raised mark to its right.
boxes.uncertainty: The small E subscript is read eta; no missing letter or mark has been supplied from mathematical expectations.

boxes.scope: Both complete words.
boxes.evidence: The first word has crossed t, dotted i strokes and terminal l. The second begins with k and the successive u/mm traces; an acute and the dotted i support kummérien. No ending punctuation is independently visible.

boxes.scope: The entire relation, its cancelled underscript and the following comma.
boxes.evidence: T and I with subscript s-prime are clear. The relation has a wavy upper stroke and straighter lower stroke. Beneath it, a diagonal cancellation crosses a low loop followed by a tall stem and a small right loop. A separate comma stands at the right.
boxes.uncertainty: The crossed underscript may read de, or just d with a terminal return; it is not securely legible. The main formula and its punctuation are high confidence.
boxes.reinspection: Existing crop reopened once to inspect the cancelled underscript; no crop was regenerated.

boxes.scope: The complete short form at the end of the source line.
boxes.evidence: The initial t has a crossbar, followed by r and a separate dot; a distinct hyphen precedes scend. The final d has a tall loop. Its connected right tail is not a separate final stop.
boxes.uncertainty: The abbreviated spelling is retained exactly; it has not been expanded.

boxes.scope: The full degree expression and comma.
boxes.evidence: deg has a tall d and descending g; the next compact group has t and r. No separate stops follow those short forms. The large letter has an upright left stroke and a joined rising/descending right stroke. A single minus precedes 1, followed by a comma.
boxes.uncertainty: K is preferred, but the joined strokes can be read as an N-like form. The faint spot after the comma is not securely punctuation.
boxes.reinspection: Existing crop reopened once to check the large letter; no crop was regenerated.

boxes.scope: The full principal phrase, excluding a fragment of the preceding line at the top.
boxes.evidence: The f in réf has its long looped descender, with a comma but no independently visible preceding full stop. disons is followed by a large Q with diagonal tail and a closing parenthesis.

boxes.scope: The complete principal line.
boxes.evidence: A single underline runs beneath presque. relèvement ends with the rising terminal t stroke. A separate long dash precedes seul le facteur, whose f and crossed t are visible.
boxes.uncertainty: The accent in relèvement is light.
boxes.display_event: An initial attempt to display this crop was truncated by the tool before inspection; the existing crop was then successfully displayed and read, without regeneration.

boxes.scope: The complete principal phrase.
boxes.evidence: obstrue has tall b, s curve and crossed t. encore is followed by two separate vertically placed dots. en tous cas follows, with no independent ending punctuation.

boxes.scope: The complete group formula, prose and normalizer formula; clipped traces at the very top belong to the previous line.
boxes.evidence: The first relation has wavy upper and straight lower strokes. E has a tilde above its small eta-shaped subscript. est plunges into plongé with a p descender, tall l and g loop. The normalizer has a nested E then X with small s; L has a small dotted i. The closing parenthesis and separate comma are visible.
boxes.uncertainty: The very small nested indices are read from their visible strokes, not supplied by a normalizer convention.

boxes.scope: All three complete words.
boxes.evidence: The two tall crossed t forms support cette. extension has an initial low e/x, a tall t, then the low continuation with a dotted i; no ending punctuation is visible.

boxes.scope: The two complete source lines inside the box.
boxes.evidence: The first line reads section de E with X_s, sur E with k(s), then a separate long dash and mais de. The second line has a single underline under deuxième only; espèce has its p descender and final full stop.

boxes.scope: The first, complete line fragment Une [cancelled glyph] autre façon. The lower-right next-line fragment is clipped and excluded.
boxes.evidence: The cancelled glyph has a tall looped stem and a long lower loop, crossed/overwritten by a further stroke. A tentative f is retained. The following autre has a crossed t, and façon has a tall f and cedilla beneath c.
boxes.uncertainty: The deleted f is not completely distinguishable from the cancelling strokes.

boxes.scope: The complete principal formula U over S. Neighboring prose/descender strokes at the left are excluded from the formula reading.
boxes.evidence: A large U with two uprights stands above a horizontal fraction bar; the S below has separate upper and lower curves.
boxes.context_note: The tall crossed/looped strokes at the left do not belong to the fraction. I have not reconstructed their neighboring word.

boxes.scope: Cancelled word and following live peut. A clipped lower-line trace is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The cancellation crosses the full width of a word beginning with a p descender and ending with a tall t-like stroke. Interior low strokes are obscured. The following live word has p, low eu and a final tall t.
boxes.uncertainty: permet is a tentative first reading of the cancelled word, with peut retained as an alternative; only the initial p and terminal t-like stroke are secure.

boxes.scope: The complete S prenant l’un phrase. The clipped d-like start of the next word at the far right belongs to B019.
boxes.evidence: The verb has a p descender, successive low r/e/n/a/n strokes and a tall terminal t. A tall l and separate apostrophe precede un. The upper clipped stroke belongs to the preceding line.

boxes.scope: All words and the final S.
boxes.evidence: des has a looped d and low es. The short form pts has a p descender, tall t and low final s, without an independent stop. de is followed by a large S; no final punctuation is visible.

boxes.scope: The entire bottom-left marginal number.
boxes.evidence: A closed upper loop with descending tail gives 9, followed by a rounded 0: 90. The black image border is not source text.
